## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `sap-s4hana-api-salesdistrict-srv-setup-g`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Verify the OData service is active

1. <!-- manual: Log in to your SAP S/4HANA system using SAP Logon or the SAP Fiori Launchpad. -->
2. <!-- manual: Open transaction SICF (HTTP Service Framework). -->
3. <!-- manual: In the service tree, navigate to default_host → sap → opu → odata → sap. -->
4. <!-- manual: Locate the service API_SALESDISTRICT_SRV and verify it is active (not grayed out). -->
5. If the service is inactive, right-select it and select **Activate Service**.

## Step 3: Register the OData service in SAP gateway (on-premise only)

1. <!-- manual: Open transaction /IWFND/MAINT_SERVICE (SAP Gateway: Activate and Maintain Services). -->
2. Select **Add Service**.
3. <!-- manual: Search for API_SALESDISTRICT_SRV in the service catalog. -->
4. Select the service and select **Add Selected Services**.
5. <!-- manual: Assign the service to a system alias (e.g., LOCAL for the same system). -->
6. <!-- manual: Save the configuration. -->

## Step 4: Obtain SAP credentials

1. <!-- manual: Navigate to the Communication Arrangements app in the Fiori Launchpad. -->
2. <!-- manual: Create a new communication arrangement for the relevant communication scenario (e.g., SAP_COM_0204 for Sales Master Data Integration). -->
3. <!-- manual: Under Communication Users, create or assign a communication user and note the auto-generated password. -->
4. <!-- manual: Use transaction SU01 to create or manage a technical user. -->
5. <!-- manual: Assign the appropriate authorization roles for calling OData services. -->
6. Note the username and password.
